# alexa-mcp
> An MCP server that acts as an acoustic bridge to control an Alexa device. It uses Text-to-Speech (TTS) to issue commands to a physical Alexa device via speakers, and Speech-to-Text (STT) to listen to ...

This project includes automated llms.txt generation for AI accessibility.
